findings.statement: loan.mori and swap.mori embed sample-specific expected amounts and reserves as source constants and guards. The independent arithmetic in this subset applies to those fixtures. The sources are not a reusable ACTUS LAM library or a general constant-product AMM.

The swap output predicate is min_out <= output_calculated. Equality at 19743 is accepted. Over-delivery relative to a lower min_out is accepted. Exact-output equality is not the existing source semantics and remains a full-RP01 challenge.
Fee factor 997/1000 changes the floor output. The action emits no Fee effect. The full 10000 AssetA_quantum input remains in the pool. The fee difference is not a separately transferred fee.
Loan settle closes the episode and retains remaining notional 4500000000 USD_micro with agreement Outstanding and two Settled tombstones. Closing the episode does not discharge residual notional.

IntentRefinement checks principal-scoped gross debit and net credits. DueCreated does not enter those ledger sums. This profile has no signed nominal-debt cap. General debt authority is successor work.

Pool outgoing Transfers are complete-effect evidence. Principal debit caps do not prove pool or provider custody authorization. That external custody and consent relation remains an MC02, MC04, and MC05 obligation before public spending.
ContractProperty, IntentRefinement, TransitionValidity, and PredecessorHistory remain named required claims. Trusted simulation checks do not prove signatures, currentness, oracle truth, or PCD.

RESOURCE_BOUNDS is a stage-12 defensive runtime count check. In the fixed admitted straight-line loan and swap sources it is unreachable. PROGRAM_BOUNDS is the stage-7 source-shape rejection. The two codes are distinct.
